transcript: Robot: Hello, what is your sun sign? Human: My sun sign is Leo. Robot: Hello, what is your name? Human: My name is Shahrukh. Robot: How old are you? Human: I have 22. Robot: I have 22 nahi, I am 22 years old hota hai. [Not 'I have 22', it is 'I am 22 years old'.] Human: Okay, okay. I am 22 years old. Robot: Where are you from? Human: I'm Uttar Pradesh. Robot: I'm Uttar Pradesh nahi, I'm from Uttar Pradesh hoga. [Not 'I'm Uttar Pradesh', it should be 'I'm from Uttar Pradesh'.] Human: Oh, theek hai, theek hai. Mujhe English acche se nahi aati. [Oh, okay, okay. I don't know English well.] Robot: Koi problem nahi. AI teacher try kiya? [No problem. Did you try an AI teacher?] Human: Wo toh mehnge hote honge na? [They must be expensive, right?] Robot: Bilkul nahi. Bas ek rupaye ka trial, chai se bhi sasta hai. Isliye lakhon log English Seekho par English practice kar rahe hain. English Seekho app pe experts 2-5 minute ke simple videos mein Hindi mein lessons dekar English bolna sikhate hain. Roz experts ke saath jo seekha, mere saath aake practice karo. Main kabhi tumhara mazak nahi udaungi. [Not at all. Just a 1-rupee trial, cheaper than tea. That's why lakhs of people practice English on English Seekho. On the English Seekho app, experts teach English speaking through simple 2-5 minute videos in Hindi. Practice what you learn daily with me. I will never make fun of you.] Human: Par time nahi milta. [But I don't get time.] Robot: Roz ki sirf 15 se 20 minute ki practice kaafi hai. Bilkul confident ho jaoge. [Just 15 to 20 minutes of daily practice is enough. You will become completely confident.] Human: Wow! Kaise join karu? [Wow! How do I join?] Robot: Ye install ka button dabao aur English Seekho app install karo. Sirf 15 dino mein tumhe improvement dikhne lagegi. Chalo, shuru ho jao. [Press this install button and install the English Seekho app. You will see improvement in just 15 days. Come on, get started.] Voiceover: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: ME NO ENGLISH, English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer text regarding educational purposes, lack of government affiliation, and results varying based on individual effort]
summary: An AI robot corrects a cricketer's English mistakes and introduces the English Seekho app. The app offers a 1-rupee trial, short Hindi-medium video lessons, and judgment-free AI practice. The ad concludes with a call to install the app for visible improvement in 15 days.
